name: Mrk 1216 (Hubble)
blurb: Mrk 1216, a compact relic galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: mrk1216-hubble
story: A small, dense galaxy that astronomers call an untouched survivor of the early universe, a red nugget that seems to have changed little since its stars formed. At its heart sits a black hole of about 4.9 billion solar masses.

claims.text: Mrk 1216 is a massive relic galaxy, an untouched survivor of the early universe's massive population (a red nugget)
Mrk 1216 is a compact galaxy that may be a passively evolved descendant
Mrk 1216's central black hole has a mass of about 4.9 billion solar masses
Mrk 1216 is a compact elliptical galaxy imaged by Hubble program GO-13050
MRK1216 was a target of Hubble program 13050
